tools.name: pwsh
tools.description: Execute a PowerShell command (`pwsh -Command`) and return its stdout/stderr. Each call runs in a fresh pwsh process; pass `workdir` instead of using `cd`. Paths use native Windows form (`C:\...`); read environment variables with `$env:NAME`. Managed `$env:DSH_*` variables expose current harness environment facts. Long output is truncated to its tail; the full output is saved to a file whose path is reported when available. On Windows a force-killed command settles as `[exit code: 1]` without a signal marker — treat it as an interruption, not a command failure. Before any delete or move, verify that the resolved absolute target path is the intended one; never run it against a computed path you have not checked. Do not assign to automatic variables such as `$HOME`; variable names are case-insensitive, so `$home` is the same read-only variable. Commands may run under a file sandbox; a blocked file operation is reported as `[sandbox: file access denied under <mode> mode]`, a policy denial: do not retry another way. Under the Windows sandbox, read-only pwsh runs in PowerShell ConstrainedLanguage mode, while workspace-write stays in FullLanguage unless host policy says otherwise. In read-only, prefer cmdlets and core types (`[string]`, `[datetime]`, `[regex]`, `[guid]`); .NET static calls (`[System.IO.*]::`, `[math]::`), `Add-Type`, COM objects, and reflection fail with "only core types" errors. `-f` formatting, property access, and core cmdlets work. In both confined modes, programs cannot open named pipes, so a command that captures another program's output through piped stdio (Node.js `child_process.spawn`/`exec` with the default `stdio: 'pipe'`) fails with EPERM, while `stdio: 'inherit'` and `stdio: 'ignore'` spawns work and PowerShell's own pipelines are unaffected. That EPERM is the documented boundary: do not retry the command another way — escalate the exact command once or restructure it to avoid capturing output.

tools.name: workflow
tools.description:
Run a JavaScript workflow script that orchestrates subagents at scale. Use this for work that fans out across many independent pieces — an audit over many files, a migration, multi-angle research, adversarial verification of findings — where you write the orchestration as a script instead of delegating turn by turn.

Script-body hooks:
- `agent(prompt, opts?): Promise<any>` — run one subagent to completion. Without `opts.schema` it resolves to the child's final text; with `opts.schema` (an object-rooted JSON Schema using ONLY type/properties/required/additionalProperties/items/enum/const/oneOf) it resolves to the validated object. Resolves `null` when the child fails (filter with `.filter(Boolean)`). Other opts: `label` (display), `phase` (progress group), and independent `provider`/`model` LLM target overrides.
- `pipeline(items, ...stages): Promise<any[]>` — run each item through the stages independently with NO barrier between stages (prefer this for multi-stage work). Each stage receives `(prev, item, index)`. A stage throw drops that ITEM to `null` and skips its remaining stages.
- `parallel(thunks): Promise<any[]>` — run zero-argument functions concurrently and await ALL of them (a barrier; use only when a stage genuinely needs every prior result together). A throwing thunk resolves to `null`.
- `phase(title)` — start a progress phase; `log(message)` — narrate progress; `args` — the tool call's `args` input, verbatim.

Misused hooks (bad arguments, unknown options, unsupported schemas, tripped caps) end the whole script instead of producing `null`. The script has no filesystem, network, timer, or Node.js APIs; the agents do the work.

script.description: The plain JavaScript body, not TypeScript and without an `export const meta` statement; top-level await is allowed. End with `return <value>`; the JSON-serializable value is this tool's result.

meta.description: The workflow identity as plain JSON, not code.

description.description: One-line description of what the workflow does.

whenToUse.description: Optional guidance on when this workflow applies.

phases.description: Optional phase declarations matched by phase() calls.

title.description: The phase title phase() calls match by exact string.

detail.description: Optional one-line description of the phase.

provider.description: Optional provider override this phase is expected to use.

model.description: Optional model override this phase is expected to use.

args.description: Optional JSON input exposed to the script as the `args` global (wrap a bare list as a field, e.g. {"files": [...]}).

run_in_background.description: Run as a background job: return a job id immediately instead of waiting; the return value arrives with the completion notice.

最符合的假设:**缓存的触摸坐标空间过期**(手机在某个时刻换了方向/分辨率,例如 2560x1184 ↔ 1184x2560),于是我们发出的所有注入坐标都落到屏幕外,被设备端**整条丢弃** —— 表现就是"所有按键都失效";而"退出重进 FPS"必然伴随**按键事件**,而按键事件正是当前**唯一**会触发坐标空间重查的路径(见 engine.rs 的 `space_recheck_due` / `Shared::space_recheck` → app.rs 的 `sync_display_space`),所以能恢复。

要做两件事:

A. **周期性重查坐标空间(主修)**
- 映射开启且控制通道在线时,每 ~2 秒(可 1.5~3s,自己定并写理由)在**工作线程**上重查一次屏幕尺寸(复用现有 `adb.rs` 的取尺寸逻辑:`dumpsys window displays`,失败回退 `wm size`),与当前缓存比较:

- 关键:**不能阻塞引擎或界面线程**,不能在持锁时做 adb 调用;沿用现有异步模式(线程 + channel,参考 app.rs 里既有的 `sync_display_space`/设备信息刷新写法)。
- 触发时机别只靠定时器:进入 FPS 模式、从"长时间空闲"恢复(已有 `space_recheck_due` 那套可以继续用)时也顺带查一次,但**定时那条必须独立存在**(用户这次的场景就是"没有按键 → 没人触发重查")。

B. **设备侧遥测(看得见)**
- 上面那次周期查询顺带取:当前焦点窗口(`dumpsys window | grep -E "mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp"`)与屏幕状态(`dumpsys display`,取亮/灭)。**只在变化时**写一条 INFO 日志(例如"焦点窗口: com.tencent.tmgp.dfm/... ")。

#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""把 `cargo clippy --all-targets` 的告警与基线比对（W2-5 / 审计方案的验证纪律之一）。

用法::

    python ci/clippy_diff.py            # 只报告，永远退出 0（信息性）
    python ci/clippy_diff.py --strict   # 出现"新增/消失"即退出 1

口径与《全面审计与提升方案-2026-10-05.md》里历次实施记录一致：

* 比对的是 **(文件, 消息文本) 去重集合**，不是行号 —— 行号每次重构都会动，
  消息文本才代表"同一类告警"；
* 基线文件 `ci/clippy-baseline.txt` 每行 `src/xxx.rs: warning: <消息>`，
  由维护者在"确认每一对都是既有构造"之后手工更新（更新时要在方案文档里记账）；
* 本机（Windows）的基线是 36 对；GitHub runner 上的 rustc 版本可能更新，
  因此 CI 把它当**信息性**步骤，不拦提交。
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import io
import os
import re
import subprocess
import sys

HERE = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(__file__))
BASELINE = os.path.join(HERE, "clippy-baseline.txt")
BS = chr(92)  # 反斜杠

# Windows 控制台/重定向管道的默认编码是 GBK 或 cp1252，直接 print 中文会炸；
# 统一按 UTF-8 输出（本项目在 Windows + Linux 两边都跑这个脚本）。
sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="replace")


def load_baseline(path: str) -> set[tuple[str, str]]:
    pairs: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    with io.open(path, encoding="utf-8") as fh:
        for line in fh:
            line = line.rstrip("\n")
            m = re.match(r"^(src[^:]+): warning: (.*)$", line)
            if m:
                pairs.add((m.group(1).replace(BS, "/"), m.group(2).strip()))
    return pairs


def run_clippy() -> set[tuple[str, str]]:
    proc = subprocess.run(
        ["cargo", "clippy", "--all-targets"],
        capture_output=True,
        text=True,
        encoding="utf-8",
        errors="replace",
    )
    pairs: set[tuple[str, str]] = set()
    current = None
    for line in proc.stderr.splitlines():
        m = re.match(r"^warning: (.*)", line)
        if m and not line.startswith("warning: `scrcpy-pad`"):
            current = m.group(1).strip()
        m2 = re.match(r"^\s+--> (src[^:]+):\d+:\d+", line)
        if m2 and current:
            pairs.add((m2.group(1).replace(BS, "/"), current))
            current = None
    return pairs


def main() -> int:
    strict = "--strict" in sys.argv
    baseline = load_baseline(BASELINE)
    current = run_clippy()
    new = sorted(current - baseline)
    gone = sorted(baseline - current)

    print(f"当前告警对: {len(current)}   基线对: {len(baseline)}")
    print("--- 新增（当前有、基线没有）---")
    for f, msg in new:
        print(f"  {f} | {msg}")
    print("--- 消失（基线有、当前没有）---")
    for f, msg in gone:
        print(f"  {f} | {msg}")

    if new or gone:
        print("提示：确认每一对都是既有构造/已消除后，更新 ci/clippy-baseline.txt 并在方案文档里记账。")
        return 1 if strict else 0

[package]
name = "scrcpy-pad"
version = "0.2.0"
edition = "2024"
description = "A keyboard-mapping game console layered on top of scrcpy (virtual joystick, tap/hold/swipe injection)"
license = "MIT"
repository = "https://github.com/Azrl-lyh/scrcpy-pad"
keywords = ["scrcpy", "android", "gamepad", "keymapping"]
categories = ["emulators", "games"]

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.104"
directories = "6.0.0"
eframe = { version = "0.36.1", default-features = false, features = ["glow", "default_fonts", "x11", "wayland"] }
egui = "0.36.1"
image = { version = "0.25.10", default-features = false, features = ["png", "jpeg"] }
# 使用说明窗口的 markdown 解析(轻量纯 Rust CommonMark 解析器,只取解析结果自行渲染到 egui)
pulldown-cmark = { version = "0.13", default-features = false }
serde = { version = "1.0.229", features = ["derive"] }
serde_json = "1.0.151"
# 键位配置改成 YAML(多套"按键组合"装在一个文件里,字段说明写在文件头注释中)。
# 用 serde_norway 而不是已归档的 serde_yaml:两者 API 一致,但它是仍在维护的分支。
serde_norway = "0.9"

# Linux: evdev 全局键盘捕获 + xdg-portal 原生文件对话框
# (rfd 的 xdg-portal 后端要求配套 async 运行时特性,选 async-std)
[target.'cfg(target_os = "linux")'.dependencies]
evdev = "0.13.2"
rfd = { version = "0.15", default-features = false, features = ["xdg-portal", "async-std"] }
pollster = "0.4"
# 诊断日志需要本地时区(与 journalctl 对齐时间线):用 localtime_r。
# libc 本来就在依赖树里(evdev 要求),所以零额外编译成本。
libc = "0.2"

# Windows: 自己装的低级键盘/鼠标钩子(见 capture.rs 的说明:rdev 在钩子回调里
# 调 AttachThreadInput/ToUnicodeEx 取一个我们用不到的 key name,会阻塞到超时并
# 被系统静默丢事件)+ 原生文件对话框 + 少量 Win32 调用
[target.'cfg(windows)'.dependencies]
rfd = { version = "0.15", default-features = false }
windows-sys = { version = "0.59", features = [
    "Win32_Foundation",
    "Win32_UI_WindowsAndMessaging",
    # Raw Input(RegisterRawInputDevices/GetRawInputData/RAWMOUSE,W1-2)由它带入
    "Win32_UI_Input_KeyboardAndMouse",
    "Win32_System_SystemInformation",
    "Win32_System_Threading",
    # 单实例守卫用 CreateMutexW:windows-sys 0.59 把它同时挂在 Win32_Security
    # 下(参数类型 SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES 属于那个模块),少了这个 feature 会 E0432。
    "Win32_Security",
    # GetModuleHandleW:Raw Input 接收窗口要按模块注册窗口类(W1-2)
    "Win32_System_LibraryLoader",
    "Win32_Graphics_Gdi",
] }

[profile.release]
lto = "thin"
codegen-units = 1
strip = true
opt-level = 2
=== baseline ===

content.text:
Good. `gui_rx` is fed by the engine (`engine::run(shared, cap_rx, gui_tx, ...)`) — the engine forwards events to the GUI. So app.rs sees all capture events. A hotkey handled in app.rs would work (engine also sees them but ignores unbound keys).

So: bindable hotkey needs keymap.rs field. Let me ask the lead now.

Actually, wait. Maybe I can implement the hotkey *without* keymap.rs by using `egui` input? The app has Ctrl+S/F5 handled via egui input at line 4691 — those work when the egui window has keyboard focus (the app grabs keyboard only when mapping enabled? The capture layer grabs keys globally but also forwards to the OS... egui still receives key events when its window is focused). So a fixed egui hotkey (e.g. Ctrl+Shift+F9) could work via `ctx.input`. But still fixed, not bindable.

Hmm, what about making it bindable through the existing "按键映射" (KeyBind) system? A KeyBind maps a key to a touch action on screen — not to an internal command.

OK, ask the lead. Let me write the message now, then implement the rest.

Message to lead:
- Status: claimed task-4, adapting to new priorities.
- Question: bindable hotkey requires a new field in `keymap.rs` (`Aim::selfcheck_key`, mirroring shield_key) — that file is outside my write scope. Options: (A) grant me keymap.rs for an additive field only (I keep engine.rs untouched; app.rs handles the key from CaptureEvent), (B) I ship the button + a fixed hotkey (F9) with no binding, documented as such. Recommend A.
- Meanwhile I'm implementing the rest (probe/telemetry/self-check/overlay/tests) so the answer only affects the hookup.

Also note: engine.rs would need to know that the key is a "system key" so it doesn't get swallowed/forwarded to the game... Actually, hmm: if the hotkey is handled in app.rs but the engine forwards the key to the device (as a mapped key) or swallows it, there's an issue: an unbound key in FPS mode — does the engine swallow it? Let's check `mouse_shield_swallows` / swallow semantics: in FPS mode, keyboard keys that aren't mapped... The capture layer's `swallow` flag controls whether keys are passed to the game. If the engine forwards the hotkey to the game, pressing F9 in-game would also send F9 to the game (if bound) — but if unbound, nothing. That's acceptable (F8 total toggle works the same way: engine consumes it).

But there's a subtlety: `functional_key_hit` in engine consumes keys so they don't reach the game? Look at engine.rs line ~4457: `if fps_consumed && !toggle_key.contains(&ev.code)`. Keys handled by engine are "system keys" and are excluded from forwarding. If the self-check key is not registered as a system key, it would... hmm, would it even reach the device? Unmapped keys in FPS mode: are they forwarded to the Android device as key events? The engine maps only bound keys; unbound physical keys are probably swallowed in FPS mode (mouse_shield) or passed to the OS. Either way, app.rs receiving the event is enough; the side effect on the game is the same as any unbound key.

So option A only needs keymap.rs field + app.rs handling. Good. Engine.rs would ideally also treat it as a system key (line 356-362 list) so it isn't recorded in macros etc. — but that's engine.rs, which I may only touch comments on. Hmm, the `system_key_member` list at 356 affects whether a key is treated as a system key (not forwarded?). If the self-check key isn't in that list, the engine might forward it to the device as if it were... let me check what `system_key_member` does at line 340-380.

This is growing. Since the lead offered "按钮 + 可绑热键", but the full correct implementation spans keymap.rs + engine.rs + app.rs, maybe the pragmatic answer: implement the button (diag panel) + **fixed hotkey handled in app.rs**, and honestly report that full binding needs keymap.rs/engine.rs scope. But the lead explicitly asked for bindable.

Let me ask the lead with a clear statement of the cost: option A = keymap.rs (field) + engine.rs (add to system-key list, ~3 lines) + app.rs (handling + bind UI). Option B = fixed egui/CaptureEvent hotkey in app.rs only, no persistence.

I'll ask and continue. Actually, to be efficient: I'll implement everything else first, and ask now so the answer is likely back by the time I need the hookup.

Let me send the message.

Then implement:

**adb.rs**:
- `DeviceProbe` + `device_probe` + parsers + `input_tap`.
- tests.

**app.rs**:
- consts: `SPACE_WATCH_INTERVAL`.
- fields: `space_watch_rx`, `space_watch_last`, `space_checked_at`, `last_focus`, `focused_app`, `last_screen_on`, `selfcheck_rx`, `selfcheck_last: Option<String>`, `selfcheck_at: Option<Instant>`, `aim_mode_prev: bool` (for FPS entry trigger).
- pure fns: `space_change_detected`, `telemetry_changed`.
- methods: `maybe_space_watch`, `start_space_watch`, `poll_space_watch`, `apply_device_probe`, `start_device_selfcheck`, `poll_device_selfcheck`, plus ui button.
- overlay fields + line.
- tests: pure fn tests.

Where to put the pure functions? app.rs tests module at 16106. Let me check the test module content near the start to follow conventions and see helper macros.

Let me now send the lead message and read app.rs test module header.
Let me ask the Lead about the hotkey scope conflict (it needs files outside my write scope), then continue implementing.

{"target": "lead", "message": "space-recheck 已认领 task-4，按你的重新定级执行（周期性重查降级为防御性改进；遥测 + 设备注入自检为重点）。

一个**范围冲突**需要你定夺（只影响"可绑热键"这一项，其余我已在写）：

可绑热键在本项目里 = `Profile` 上的一个 `KeySet` 字段（先例：`Aim::shield_key`），字段声明/serde 默认/注释都在 **src/keymap.rs**，而绑定槽位在 app.rs；engine 还要把它登记进"系统键"名单（`src/engine.rs` 356/473 行那两处 `system_key_member`/`swallowed` 列表），否则这个键会被当成普通按键走映射路径。keymap.rs 和 engine.rs 都在我的写范围之外。

- 选项 A（推荐）：把写范围扩到 `src/keymap.rs`（只加一个 `Aim::selfcheck_key: KeySet`，仿 shield_key）和 `src/engine.rs`（那两处列表各加一行；不加任何逻辑）。app.rs 自己从 `CaptureEvent` 认这个键并发起自检，不碰 engine 事件流。
- 选项 B：只做按钮，热键用**固定键**（我在 app.rs 里读 `CaptureEvent::Button`，例如 F9，不落配置、不可改），报告里写明"不可绑"。

我倾向 A（与你要的"可绑"一致，改动是纯增量、无逻辑）。你回一个字母即可；在等到回复前我会先把 DeviceProbe/遥测/自检线程/悬浮窗/单测/诊断面板按钮全部写完，A/B 只决定最后那段接线。

另：基线 `cargo test --bin scrcpy-pad` 我这边是 **303 passed / 1 failed**，失败的是 `instance::tests::another_process_holding_the_guard_is_detected`，原因是本机正跑着一个真实 `scrcpy-pad.exe`（PID 39436）占着单实例守卫。要不要我结束那个进程再跑门禁？（不结束的话这条会一直是红，其余 303 全绿。）"}

The natural place for the bind UI is the diagnostics panel itself (next to the button) — simpler than mirroring the FPS panel. I'll add the bind control right next to the self-check button in `ui_diagnostics`:

```rust
ui.label("自检热键:");  + keys_button + cancel_bind_button
```

That means KeySlot::AimSelfCheck + assign_keys + vk_slot_keys + begin_keys_capture + cancel handling. That's the shield_key pattern minimally.

Also `PENDING_TASK_LABELS`? no.

Also the macro recording: the hotkey during macro recording would be recorded as a step — same as shield_key behavior, fine.

Now the self-check trigger from CaptureEvent::Button: in the gui_events loop, after the macro-recording branch? Careful: if recording a macro, all buttons are recorded and `continue`. If I put my hotkey check before the macro branch, then during macro recording the hotkey would trigger a self-check instead of being recorded — that's the desirable behavior for a "system key" (like F8). For shield: engine handles it, and during macro recording the engine... The engine checks `functional_key_hit` and shield; and macro recording is an app-side state (`self.macro_recording`), while engine still processes system keys. So system keys are handled by the engine even while recording. For our app-side hotkey, the check must be **before** the `macro_recording` continue branch to behave like a system key. Also before the `waiting_key`/`waiting_keys` binding capture? If the user is binding a key and presses the self-check hotkey, it should be recorded as the new binding, not trigger a self-check. Hmm — similar to how the engine handles system keys... For `waiting_keys` the app captures it. If the current selfcheck hotkey is pressed while binding another slot, the app should bind it (user intent). The current code order: swallow_cancel_click → macro_recording → waiting_keys → waiting_key → ... So if I insert my hotkey check right after `swallow_cancel_click` (before macro_recording), then during binding-capture the hotkey triggers self-check instead of binding. Slightly wrong but the user can use another key; and it also protects against "self-check fired while binding". Hmm.

Better placement: after the waiting_key/waiting_keys branches but before other handling — i.e. right after the two capture branches, so binding takes priority. But then during macro recording (which comes first with `continue`), the hotkey would be recorded as a macro step rather than triggering. Which is more desirable? For a diagnostic instrument, triggering during macro recording would inject an unexpected tap into the phone mid-recording — bad. So being recorded as a step / ignored is safer. Hmm, but then the hotkey "doesn't work" while recording. Acceptable (recording is a deliberate modal state).

Wait, but actually the macro branch records the button; then the engine also sees the event and treats it as a system key (not forwarded). Fine.

So: place the hotkey check right after the `waiting_keys`/`waiting_key` capture blocks... but those blocks `continue` when capturing. Let me look at the exact structure: after `if let (Some(slot), true) = (self.waiting_key, pressed)` block ends around 5060, what follows? Let me read 5055-5120 to find a good insertion point and see the full event loop.

Actually simpler: insert right after the swallow_cancel_click check but guard `if self.macro_recording.is_none() && self.waiting_key.is_none() && self.waiting_keys.is_none()` → clean and explicit. Hmm, that's a bit convoluted; better to insert after the capture branches where those are None anyway.

Let me read 5055-5130 to place it.

Also need: only trigger on `pressed == true` (fresh press? there may be repeats). Use `pressed` only; key repeat may send repeated Button pressed events? For keyboard auto-repeat, the capture layer may send repeated down events. For F8, engine uses `functional_key_hit(..., fresh_press)`. {"id":"task-4","revision":2,"subject":"周期性重查触摸坐标空间 + 设备侧遥测（"所有按键失效 / 重进 FPS 恢复"的主修）","description":"背景(真机证据,2026-10-11):用户触摸手机屏之后**所有注入按键全部失效**(开火/移动/视角全不灵),而本程序界面显示"按键在按、压枪在生效"(引擎侧认为一切正常);退出重进 FPS 模式即恢复。日志(23:18:32 会话)显示:控制通道建立时坐标空间 = `2772x1280`,整场**没有任何"触摸坐标空间已更新"**;全程零 WARN(无对账/无 watchdog/无写失败)。此前已排除:捕获层(位移确实到引擎)、触点泄漏(全配平)、触点池满、Raw 通道静默、隔膜范围。

最符合的假设:**缓存的触摸坐标空间过期**(手机在某个时刻换了方向/分辨率,例如 2560x1184 ↔ 1184x2560),于是我们发出的所有注入坐标都落到屏幕外,被设备端**整条丢弃** —— 表现就是"所有按键都失效";而"退出重进 FPS"必然伴随**按键事件**,而按键事件正是当前**唯一**会触发坐标空间重查的路径(见 engine.rs 的 `space_recheck_due` / `Shared::space_recheck` → app.rs 的 `sync_display_space`),所以能恢复。

要做两件事:

A. **周期性重查坐标空间(主修)**
- 映射开启且控制通道在线时,每 ~2 秒(可 1.5~3s,自己定并写理由)在**工作线程**上重查一次屏幕尺寸(复用现有 `adb.rs` 的取尺寸逻辑:`dumpsys window displays`,失败回退 `wm size`),与当前缓存比较:
  - 变了 → 走**已经实现**的那条路:更新尺寸 + 抬起所有触点 + 失效 `AimState::anchor_used`(见 app.rs `sync_display_space` 与 `Shared::space_changed_release` 的既有语义),并写一条 INFO 日志(含旧/新尺寸)。
  - 没变 → 什么都不做(不要写日志,别刷屏;调试级别可留 debug)。
- 关键:**不能阻塞引擎或界面线程**,不能在持锁时做 adb 调用;沿用现有异步模式(线程 + channel,参考 app.rs 里既有的 `sync_display_space`/设备信息刷新写法)。
- 触发时机别只靠定时器:进入 FPS 模式、从"长时间空闲"恢复(已有 `space_recheck_due` 那套可以继续用)时也顺带查一次,但**定时那条必须独立存在**(用户这次的场景就是"没有按键 → 没人触发重查")。

B. **设备侧遥测(看得见)**
- 上面那次周期查询顺带取:当前焦点窗口(`dumpsys window | grep -E "mCurrentFocus|mFocusedApp"`)与屏幕状态(`dumpsys display`,取亮/灭)。**只在变化时**写一条 INFO 日志(例如"焦点窗口: com.tencent.tmgp.dfm/... ")。
- 把"当前坐标空间 + 上次重查时刻"暴露到界面:优先并入 task-3 已经在做的那个悬浮状态行(若 task-3 已完成,直接扩它的行;`DebugOverlayData` 里加字段)。**不要**新增开关。

纪律:
- 只用 bash(ops_bash),**绝对不要**用 pwsh/PowerShell。
- 三道门全过并原文回报:`cargo fmt --check`、`cargo test --bin scrcpy-pad`(写明 passed 数,基线以你开工时为准)、`python ci/clippy_diff.py`(必须与基线零差异)。
- 不新增依赖;不改 Cargo.toml。
- 必须给单测:①"尺寸变化 → 必须触发收手/更新"这条判定的纯函数级单测(把比较逻辑抽成纯函数最好);②"尺寸没变 → 不触发"的对照。adb 调用本身用注入/替身或跳过,说明清楚。
- 写范围:src/app.rs, src/adb.rs, 以及(仅在必要时)src/engine.rs 的 `Shared::space_recheck` 相邻注释。**不要**碰 src/main.rs、src/trace.rs、src/instance.rs、src/keymap.rs、src/help.md、src/capture.rs。
- 报告里必须写清"没验证到的部分"(尤其:真机上空间变化是否真能复现、GUI 是否走查)。","status":"in_progress","blockedBy":["task-3"],"writeScopes":["src/app.rs","src/adb.rs"],"ownerName":"space-recheck","ready":false,"writeScopeWarnings":[]}

{"target": "lead", "message": "task-4 已 complete。按你最新口径降级交付：**周期性坐标空间重查 = 防御性改进（不是根因修复）**，遥测 + 设备注入自检（按钮）为重点。

- `DeviceProbe` + `device_probe()`：一次巡检取坐标空间（沿用 `dumpsys window displays` 的 `cur=`，解析不到回退 `wm size`）+ 焦点窗口 + 前台 Activity + 屏幕亮灭；每条查询失败都如实返回 None，不猜。
- `DeviceProbe::size_is_display_space`：标出尺寸是"真 `cur=`"还是回退的 `wm size`——回退值是自然方向物理分辨率，横屏下与真实空间差 90°，只能看不能用来判"变了"。
- `input_tap()`：`adb shell input tap x y`，失败原因原文返回（自检器械的对照那一路）。
- `parse_window_field()` / `parse_screen_on()`：焦点字段（`null` 原样保留 = 真实"无焦点窗口"）、亮灭只认 ON/OFF（DOZE/UNKNOWN 一律"未知"）。
`src/app.rs`：
- `SPACE_WATCH_INTERVAL = 2s` 常量，注释里写明三条理由 + **"防御性、非已验证修复"**的口径。
- 纯函数 `space_change_detected`（尺寸变了才 true；没查到 / 回退值 / 0 尺寸都不动）、`probe_snapshot_is_fresh`（挡"探针飞在路上时别处已更新空间"→ 否则会把空间倒退回去）、`telemetry_changed`（只在变化时写日志）、`short_focus`（焦点窗口取组件名，供悬浮窗短显示）。
- 字段：`space_watch_rx/space_watch_last/space_checked_at/probe_focus/probe_focused_app/probe_screen_on/selfcheck_rx/selfcheck_note/selfcheck_at/aim_mode_prev`；**与既有 `space_rx` 刻意分开**（那条是事件触发的一次性请求，会被[取消坐标刷新]清掉；这条只认定时器）。
- `maybe_space_watch/start_space_watch/poll_space_watch/apply_device_probe`：工作线程 + channel，绝不在持锁时做 adb；尺寸变化走既有 `sync_display_space` → `Shared::space_changed_release`。
- `sync_display_space`：日志改成带**旧/新**尺寸（`触摸坐标空间已更新为 WxH(原 OWxOH;已请求抬起旧空间触点)`），保留原前缀便于日志检索。
- `ui()`：每帧收结果 + 起下一轮；另加"进入 FPS 模式"（`aim_live.mode_active` 上升沿）顺带补查一次。
- `ui_diagnostics`：新增「设备注入自检」按钮（文案明说会在手机上点一下）+ 最近一次结论 + 焦点/屏幕状态；`start_device_selfcheck/poll_device_selfcheck` 做成独立方法 —— **你之后接热键只需调这一句**。
- `ui_debug_overlay`：`DebugOverlayData` 加 `space/space_rechecked/focus/selfcheck`，那行扩成 `… 映射={} | 空间={} 重查={} 焦点={} 自检={} | Raw=…`；窗口默认尺寸 420x210 → 520x280（行变长，免得[关闭悬浮]被挤出可视区）。
`src/keymap.rs`：**已按你要求完整撤回**（我加的两处已复原，全仓 `selfcheck_key` 零命中）；`src/engine.rs` 我一行未碰。

**3) 三道门原文**（最终工作区，刚跑）
```
===== cargo fmt --check =====
fmt exit=0

===== cargo test --bin scrcpy-pad =====
test result: ok. 310 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 1.54s

===== clippy_diff =====
当前告警对: 36   基线对: 36
--- 新增（当前有、基线没有）---
--- 消失（基线有、当前没有）---
与基线零差异。
```
（开工基线 304 passed / 36 对零差异 → 现在 310 passed，clippy 仍零差异；无新增依赖、未改 Cargo.toml。）

**4) 新增单测名（6 个）**
- `app::tests::space_change_detection_fires_on_a_real_change_only` ← ①"变了→必须触发收手/更新" + ②"没变→不动作"对照，另含"没查到""回退 wm size""0 尺寸"三种不动手
- `app::tests::stale_probe_snapshots_are_not_allowed_to_move_the_space`
- `app::tests::telemetry_changes_only_when_there_is_a_new_value`
- `app::tests::short_focus_keeps_only_the_component`
- `adb::tests::parses_focus_and_focused_app_from_window_dump`
- `adb::tests::parses_screen_power_state_only_when_unambiguous`
adb 真调用怎么测的：判定逻辑抽成**纯函数**（单测不碰进程）；解析用真实格式 fixture；**额外的端到端验证**是我临时加了个 `#[ignore]` 测试直连真机跑 `device_probe`（结果见下），跑完已删除、residue grep 干净、删后三道门重跑为上面那份。

**真机只读取证**（用你 settings.json 里的 adb 与序列号；**没有**执行 `input tap`，不打扰用户现场）：
- `dumpsys window displays` 实含 1 条 `cur=2772x1280` + `mCurrentFocus=Window{183f55e u0 com.tencent.tmgp.dfm/com.epicgames.ue4.GameActivity}` + `mFocusedApp=ActivityRecord{fcfc8f6 u0 … t3548}` → 我的解析与 `short_focus` 命中真实格式（焦点无需走第二条 fallback）
- `dumpsys display` 实含 1 条 `mScreenState=ON`
- `wm size` = `Physical size: 1280x2772`，而真实触摸空间是 `2772x1280` → **真机上就存在"回退值与真实空间正好转置"**，`size_is_display_space` 那道闸门确有其事
- 临时 `#[ignore]` 测试直连真机：`PROBE: 空间=2772x1280 焦点=Window{…GameActivity} 前台=ActivityRecord{… t3548} 屏幕=亮`，`size_is_display_space=true`，单轮巡检 ~0.13s（手工测：`dumpsys window displays` 75ms + `dumpsys display` 97ms ≈ 172ms/轮）

**5) 我没验证到的部分**
- **真机上"空间真的变了→收手重落"没复现**：我没有让手机转屏/改分辨率（也不敢注入），所以链路只有"纯函数 + 代码路径 + 真机取数"三重证据，**没有一次真机上的尺寸变化实测**。
- **GUI 没走查**：程序界面我一次都没打开（用户实例在跑，我没碰）。按钮布局、那行折行后[关闭悬浮]是否可见、`520x280` 默认尺寸是否合适，全是编译级 + 逻辑级验证，**视觉未验证**。
- **自检按钮没真按过**：`adb shell input tap` 我从未执行（会真的点用户手机）。命令形式标准，但"点下去确实生效、与我们的注入形成对照"未实测。
- 巡检负载只在空载测量：没在"游戏+投屏+映射开着"的实时场景下测过 adb 并发影响。
- "进入 FPS 模式补查一次"只有编译验证，未观察它触发。
- 已知设计取舍（非 bug）：若某 ROM 的 `dumpsys` 从不输出 `cur=`，回退值被闸门挡下 ⇒ 周期空间修复在该机型上静默不动作（`wm size` 本身也判不出方向，无损失，已在注释写明）。
- 那 36 对 clippy 基线里可能因你这版 `aim_flush` 改动而变化的部分与我无关；我这次跑的是**当时的工作区**（含你 23:26 的 engine.rs）。"}

- `parse_window_field()` / `parse_screen_on()`：焦点字段（`null` 原样保留 = 真实"无焦点窗口"）、亮灭只认 ON/OFF（DOZE/UNKNOWN 一律"未知"）。
`src/app.rs`：
- `SPACE_WATCH_INTERVAL = 2s` 常量，注释里写明三条理由 + **"防御性、非已验证修复"**的口径。
- 纯函数 `space_change_detected`（尺寸变了才 true；没查到 / 回退值 / 0 尺寸都不动）、`probe_snapshot_is_fresh`（挡"探针飞在路上时别处已更新空间"→ 否则会把空间倒退回去）、`telemetry_changed`（只在变化时写日志）、`short_focus`（焦点窗口取组件名，供悬浮窗短显示）。
- 字段：`space_watch_rx/space_watch_last/space_checked_at/probe_focus/probe_focused_app/probe_screen_on/selfcheck_rx/selfcheck_note/selfcheck_at/aim_mode_prev`；**与既有 `space_rx` 刻意分开**（那条是事件触发的一次性请求，会被[取消坐标刷新]清掉；这条只认定时器）。
- `maybe_space_watch/start_space_watch/poll_space_watch/apply_device_probe`：工作线程 + channel，绝不在持锁时做 adb；尺寸变化走既有 `sync_display_space` → `Shared::space_changed_release`。
- `sync_display_space`：日志改成带**旧/新**尺寸（`触摸坐标空间已更新为 WxH(原 OWxOH;已请求抬起旧空间触点)`），保留原前缀便于日志检索。
- `ui()`：每帧收结果 + 起下一轮；另加"进入 FPS 模式"（`aim_live.mode_active` 上升沿）顺带补查一次。
- `ui_diagnostics`：新增「设备注入自检」按钮（文案明说会在手机上点一下）+ 最近一次结论 + 焦点/屏幕状态；`start_device_selfcheck/poll_device_selfcheck` 做成独立方法 —— **你之后接热键只需调这一句**。
- `ui_debug_overlay`：`DebugOverlayData` 加 `space/space_rechecked/focus/selfcheck`，那行扩成 `… 映射={} | 空间={} 重查={} 焦点={} 自检={} | Raw=…`；窗口默认尺寸 420x210 → 520x280（行变长，免得[关闭悬浮]被挤出可视区）。
`src/keymap.rs`：**已按你要求完整撤回**（我加的两处已复原，全仓 `selfcheck_key` 零命中）；`src/engine.rs` 我一行未碰。

**3) 三道门原文**（最终工作区，刚跑）
```
===== cargo fmt --check =====
fmt exit=0

===== cargo test --bin scrcpy-pad =====
test result: ok. 310 passed; 0 failed; 0 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out; finished in 1.54s

===== clippy_diff =====
当前告警对: 36   基线对: 36
--- 新增（当前有、基线没有）---
--- 消失（基线有、当前没有）---
与基线零差异。
```
（开工基线 304 passed / 36 对零差异 → 现在 310 passed，clippy 仍零差异；无新增依赖、未改 Cargo.toml。）

**4) 新增单测名（6 个）**
- `app::tests::space_change_detection_fires_on_a_real_change_only` ← ①"变了→必须触发收手/更新" + ②"没变→不动作"对照，另含"没查到""回退 wm size""0 尺寸"三种不动手
- `app::tests::stale_probe_snapshots_are_not_allowed_to_move_the_space`
- `app::tests::telemetry_changes_only_when_there_is_a_new_value`
- `app::tests::short_focus_keeps_only_the_component`
- `adb::tests::parses_focus_and_focused_app_from_window_dump`
- `adb::tests::parses_screen_power_state_only_when_unambiguous`
adb 真调用怎么测的：判定逻辑抽成**纯函数**（单测不碰进程）；解析用真实格式 fixture；**额外的端到端验证**是我临时加了个 `#[ignore]` 测试直连真机跑 `device_probe`（结果见下），跑完已删除、residue grep 干净、删后三道门重跑为上面那份。

**真机只读取证**（用你 settings.json 里的 adb 与序列号；**没有**执行 `input tap`，不打扰用户现场）：
- `dumpsys window displays` 实含 1 条 `cur=2772x1280` + `mCurrentFocus=Window{183f55e u0 com.tencent.tmgp.dfm/com.epicgames.ue4.GameActivity}` + `mFocusedApp=ActivityRecord{fcfc8f6 u0 … t3548}` → 我的解析与 `short_focus` 命中真实格式（焦点无需走第二条 fallback）
- `dumpsys display` 实含 1 条 `mScreenState=ON`
- `wm size` = `Physical size: 1280x2772`，而真实触摸空间是 `2772x1280` → **真机上就存在"回退值与真实空间正好转置"**，`size_is_display_space` 那道闸门确有其事
- 临时 `#[ignore]` 测试直连真机：`PROBE: 空间=2772x1280 焦点=Window{…GameActivity} 前台=ActivityRecord{… t3548} 屏幕=亮`，`size_is_display_space=true`，单轮巡检 ~0.13s（手工测：`dumpsys window displays` 75ms + `dumpsys display` 97ms ≈ 172ms/轮）

**5) 我没验证到的部分**
- **真机上"空间真的变了→收手重落"没复现**：我没有让手机转屏/改分辨率（也不敢注入），所以链路只有"纯函数 + 代码路径 + 真机取数"三重证据，**没有一次真机上的尺寸变化实测**。
- **GUI 没走查**：程序界面我一次都没打开（用户实例在跑，我没碰）。按钮布局、那行折行后[关闭悬浮]是否可见、`520x280` 默认尺寸是否合适，全是编译级 + 逻辑级验证，**视觉未验证**。
- **自检按钮没真按过**：`adb shell input tap` 我从未执行（会真的点用户手机）。命令形式标准，但"点下去确实生效、与我们的注入形成对照"未实测。
- 巡检负载只在空载测量：没在"游戏+投屏+映射开着"的实时场景下测过 adb 并发影响。
- "进入 FPS 模式补查一次"只有编译验证，未观察它触发。
- 已知设计取舍（非 bug）：若某 ROM 的 `dumpsys` 从不输出 `cur=`，回退值被闸门挡下 ⇒ 周期空间修复在该机型上静默不动作（`wm size` 本身也判不出方向，无损失，已在注释写明）。
- 那 36 对 clippy 基线里可能因你这版 `aim_flush` 改动而变化的部分与我无关；我这次跑的是**当时的工作区**（含你 23:26 的 engine.rs）。"}
